tools.name: index_repository
tools.description: Index a repository into the codebase-memory graph, creating or refreshing a project.

path.description: Absolute path to the repository root to index.

project.description: Project name to create or refresh. Defaults to the directory name.

force.description: Re-index every file even when unchanged.

tools.name: search_graph
tools.description: Search graph nodes by symbol name pattern and/or file pattern. Set format to "json" for a machine-readable {cols,groups,rows} payload.

label.description: Restrict to one node label (function, class, …).

tools.name: query_graph
tools.description: Run a structured query against the codebase graph.

tools.name: trace_path
tools.description: Trace call or dependency paths between two graph nodes.

from.description: Qualified name of the source node.

to.description: Qualified name of the target node.

tools.name: get_code_snippet
tools.description: Return the source lines behind a graph node or a file range.

tools.name: get_graph_schema
tools.description: Describe the graph's node labels, edge types and properties.

tools.name: get_architecture
tools.description: Summarize a project's architecture from the graph: modules, layers and their dependencies.

tools.name: search_code
tools.description: Search indexed source text within a project.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List every indexed project with its recorded repository path.

tools.name: delete_project
tools.description: Delete an indexed project and its graph data.

tools.name: index_status
tools.description: Report a project's index state: file and symbol counts, staleness, last index time.

tools.name: check_index_coverage
tools.description: Report per-path index coverage for a list of paths: status, freshness and recommended action.

paths.description: Paths to check, relative to the project root.

tools.name: detect_changes
tools.description: List files that changed since the project was last indexed.

since.description: Optional revision or timestamp to compare against.

tools.name: manage_adr
tools.description: Create, list or read architecture decision records attached to a project.

tools.name: ingest_traces
tools.description: Ingest runtime traces into the graph to enrich call relationships.
